name: Nujuma, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
insider_take: This ultra-exclusive resort on a pristine Red Sea island redefines luxury with just 63 villas scattered across untouched coral reefs and pristine beaches accessible only by seaplane.
whats_special: Nujuma occupies its own private island in the Red Sea Project, featuring overwater and beachfront villas with direct access to some of the world's most pristine coral reefs. The resort operates as Saudi Arabia's first Ritz-Carlton Reserve, offering unprecedented privacy with a dedicated marine biologist and the region's most exclusive diving experiences.
pro_tip: Book the Royal Reserve Villa for the ultimate experience - it comes with a private beach, dedicated chef, and exclusive access to untouched dive sites that are off-limits to other resorts.
dont_miss: The sunrise yoga sessions on floating platforms above the coral gardens, night diving with bioluminescent plankton, and the resort's signature "Coral Restoration Experience" where you can help plant new coral formations in the house reef.
pros: Ultra-luxury Ritz-Carlton Reserve experience with unparalleled service standards
Exclusive private island location in pristine Red Sea waters
World-class diving and snorkeling with vibrant coral reefs
Spacious overwater and beachfront villas with private pools
cons: Extremely remote location requiring multiple transfers
Ultra-premium pricing reflecting exclusive Reserve status
